thread:
bob (Customer): Hey team, we're getting strange responses from /v1/rerank — sometimes 404 with "model_not_found", other times scores are all zeros. Started after yesterday's deploy. Impacting search ranking in prod :grimacing:

alice (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, @bob. Can you paste the exact request body + the response (including headers) and a request id if present? Any tenant/model_id you're using?

bob (Customer): Sure. Request id from headers: req_202603141030_9cfa. We're calling model_id: "rerank-legacy-2022" via the normal tenant endpoint. Curl below:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model_id":"rerank-legacy-2022","inputs":[{"query":"best noise cancelling headphones","candidates":["headphone A","headphone B","headphone C"]}]}'
```

Response (truncated):
```
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: req_202603141030_9cfa
{
  "error": {"code":"model_not_found","message":"model rerank-legacy-2022 is deprecated or does not exist"}
}
```

When it doesn't 404 the payload returns: `scores: [0,0,0]` for every request.

alice (Support): Thanks. That request id helps. @carol / @dave can you check the routing logs for that req id and confirm whether the legacy model was removed or aliased?

carol (Eng-ML): looking. Req id resolves to node-rerank-03. I can see a request trace: the control plane returned a model variant `rerank-legacy-2022` which maps to an archived model artifact. We deprecated that artifact last month and removed the runtime bundles in the latest infra prune. The control plane should have returned a 400 with deprecation hint, but infra attempted to route and got 404 from the runtime.

carol (Eng-ML): The all-zero scores are from a fallback codepath: if the runtime fails to load weights but the scoring graph skeleton is present, it emits zeros to avoid latency spikes. That's a bug — should return a 5xx not a valid response.

dave (Eng-Infra): Confirmed: prune job ran yesterday 03:15 UTC and cleaned up `rerank-legacy-*` bundles from shared artifact store. We didn't update tenant alias mappings for org:acme-tenant which still had model_id pinned to `rerank-legacy-2022`. That explains why some requests 404 (no runtime) and some return zeros (partial load on warmed node).

erin (CS): @bob I'm really sorry about the outage. We're preparing a hotfix. For a short-term workaround you can: 1) switch model_id to `rerank-v2-compact` (recommended) or 2) add `model_version: latest` to the payload to force routing to the new alias. We can patch your tenant to point to `rerank-v2-compat` if you want us to do it for you.

bob (Customer): We want the patch. We can't ship a code change on our side tonight. Please patch tenant mapping. Also, do we need to re-score historical queries?

alice (Support): Copying that. @dave can you update alias for org:acme-tenant -> `rerank-v2-compact` and keep a read-only redirect to the old id for 24h?

dave (Eng-Infra): I can add a tenant override mapping. Patch plan: add mapping in control-plane config, redeploy routing config, and add a temporary compatibility alias that logs any use of `rerank-legacy-2022`. ETA 30m. I'll run the change with canary to avoid blast radius.

deploy-bot: deployment started by dave — routing-config v2026.03.14_hotfix (canary=10%) :rocket:

carol (Eng-ML): One more note — `rerank-v2-compact` scoring returns normalized logits; v1 used a different scorer scale. If you switch models you'll see rank order preserved in most cases but absolute scores differ. If you rely on thresholds, we should advise retuning thresholds.

bob (Customer): Noted. We'll retune thresholds tomorrow. Thanks for the quick response.

alice (Support): dave — please post the change diff and the request ids for validation so we can confirm with @bob when it's live.

dave (Eng-Infra): Patch diff (small):
```
- tenants.acme.model_id: rerank-legacy-2022
+ tenants.acme.model_id: rerank-v2-compact
+ tenants.acme.legacy_redirect: rerank-legacy-2022 (log-only, 24h)
```
Canary logs: req_202603141120_a1b2 - routed to rerank-v2-compact okay; req_202603141125_c3d4 - legacy redirect hit and logged. Full rollout in 12 minutes if no errors.

carol (Eng-ML): After routing to rerank-v2-compact the same sample request returns: `scores: [0.87, 0.42, 0.23]`, and ranking order is A > B > C. Looks good in canary.

deploy-bot: canary reached 10% nodes, health checks green :white_check_mark:

alice (Support): @bob can you re-run your request (same token) and paste the new response when you see it?

bob (Customer): Re-ran at 18:45 PDT, got: HTTP 200, x-request-id: req_202603141230_ef56, body:
```
{"outputs":[{"candidates":["headphone A","headphone B","headphone C"],"scores":[0.893,0.402,0.215]}]}
```
Looks good. No more 404s.

erin (CS): We're going to keep the legacy redirect for 24 hours and then remove it after notifying customers. Also opening a follow-up to patch the runtime so that on model load failure we return a 5xx instead of zero scores.

carol (Eng-ML): Filed issue INF-2289 for the zero-score fallback. Assigning to runtime team.

dave (Eng-Infra): Rolling out full change now. deploy-bot: rollout complete, routing-config v2026.03.14_hotfix deployed to 100% :tada:

deploy-bot: deployment completed successfully (duration 00:12:34) — rollout id roll_20260314_09

alice (Support): Marking this thread resolved for now. @bob if anything odd appears during your threshold tuning please re-open and we'll prioritize. Apologies again. :heart:

bob (Customer): Thanks everyone. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

carol (Eng-ML): Quick postmortem notes for the channel: 1) prune job needs to gate on active tenant alias checks, 2) control plane should emit deprecation warnings to tenants using deprecated model ids on policy change, 3) runtime should fail loudly on missing weights. I'll draft an RFC.

dave (Eng-Infra): We'll add a guard to the prune workflow and a smoke test during rollout.

alice (Support): Closing.
